args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18) since its latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully (status: rolled_out).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), reporting unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback completed successfully (status: `rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
